The tunnel axis is parallel to the strike of beds and the beds dip 45⁰ – 60⁰
The tunnel axis is parallel to the strike of beds and the beds are vertical

questions.text: Which ones of the following are formed by brittle deformation?  [MSQ, 2 marks]
The value of φ (phi) of a sediment grain having a diameter of 0.125 mm is ________. (In integer)  [NAT, 1 mark] Numerical answer type — no options.

The vertical separation of a displaced horizontal stratum along a dip-slip reverse fault is 10 m when measured on a section perpendicular to the fault-strike. If the dip of the fault is 30⁰, the net slip of the fault will be ________ m. (In integer)  [NAT, 1 mark] Numerical answer type — no options.

The dips of the normal and overturned limbs of a horizontal-overturned antiform are 30⁰ and 70⁰, respectively. The interlimb angle of this fold is ________ degrees. (In integer)  [NAT, 1 mark] Numerical answer type — no options.
In a mineral with formula KAl3Si3O10(F0.5OHx), the value of 'x' is ________. (Round off to one decimal place)  [NAT, 1 mark] Numerical answer type — no options.
The atom percent of Fe in pyrrhotite of composition Fe0.77S is _______. (Round off to two decimal places)  [NAT, 1 mark] Numerical answer type — no options.

The geothermal gradient in the continental crust is 0.02 ⁰C/m. If the surface temperature is 25 ⁰C, the temperature at a depth of 18 km from the surface is ______ ⁰C. (In integer)  [NAT, 1 mark] Numerical answer type — no options.

The area of a triangular block of a massive orebody is 1500 m2. If the thickness of the orebody is 5 m, 6 m and 7 m at the three corners of the triangular block, and the ore density is 2.5 tons/m3, the estimated ore reserve of the block is _______ tons. (In integer)  [NAT, 1 mark] Numerical answer type — no options.

Clinopyroxene crystallizing from a basaltic magma has Sm concentration of 24 ppm. If the clinopyroxene-melt partition coefficient for Sm is 1.2, the concentration of Sm in the basaltic magma will be _______ ppm. (In integer)  [NAT, 2 marks] Numerical answer type — no options.

The lithostatic pressure at a depth of 36.5 km in the continental crust having an average density of 2800 kg/m3, is _______GPa. (Round off to the nearest integer) (Use g = 9.8 m/s2)  [NAT, 2 marks] Numerical answer type — no options.

The fraction of 24 11Na atoms remaining after a decay interval of 5.0 hours will be _______. (Round off to three decimal places) (Use t1/2 = 15.0 hours)  [NAT, 2 marks] Numerical answer type — no options.

The thickness of a dipping coal bed measured along a vertical drill hole is 15 m. If the dip of the coal bed is 30⁰, the orthogonal thickness of the coal bed is _______ m. (Round off to the nearest integer)  [NAT, 2 marks] Numerical answer type — no options. Q.55  The mole fraction of forsterite in olivine with MgO = 29.17 weight %, FeO =
34.65 weight % and SiO2 = 36.18 weight % is _______. (Round off to two decimal places) (Use molecular weight, in g/mol, of MgO = 40.31, FeO = 71.85 and SiO2 = 60.00)  [NAT, 2 marks] Numerical answer type — no options.

A partially saturated soil sample has a volume of 1200 cc. The volume of water present in the sample is 300 cc. The mass of solid in the sample is 1908 g and the particle density is 2.65 g/cc. The porosity (n) of the soil sample is _____ %. (In integer)  [NAT, 2 marks] Numerical answer type — no options.

A rock element during deformation, experienced a pressure change of 5×104 N/m2, due to which its volume changed from 4 cm3 to 3.9 cm3. The bulk modulus of the rock is _______ ×106 N/m2. (In integer)  [NAT, 2 marks] Numerical answer type — no options.

For an anisotropic crystal of thickness 0.04 mm and refractive indices of 1.636 and 1.486 along the slow and fast directions, respectively, the retardation produced is _______ nm. (In integer)  [NAT, 2 marks] Numerical answer type — no options.

An orebody contains pyrite and chalcopyrite in the same molar proportions. The percentage concentration of Cu in the ore will be _______. (Round off to the nearest integer) (Use atomic weight, in g/mol, of Cu = 63.55, Fe = 55.85, S = 32.06)  [NAT, 2 marks] Numerical answer type — no options.
